mapper.sql: SELECT a.id, a.shop_id, a.order_id, a.after_sale_no, a.order_no, a.after_sale_type, a.status, a.reason, a.remark, a.images, a.merchant_remark, a.is_deleted, a.created_at, a.updated_at, o.user_id, o.consignee, o.phone, o.region, o.detail_address, o.pay_type, o.pay_at, o.pay_amount, o.order_status FROM after_sales a LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.id = a.order_id AND o.shop_id = a.shop_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO after_sales (shop_id, order_id, order_no, after_sale_no, after_sale_type, status, reason, remark, images, merchant_remark, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{shopId}, #{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{afterSaleNo}, #{afterSaleType}, #{status}, #{reason}, #{remark}, #{images}, #{merchantRemark}, 0, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.is_deleted = 0 AND a.shop_id = #{shopId}
